title: Genesis 2:10 and Revelation 20:8 — four rivers and the four corners of the earth
summary: Two quoted passages: Genesis 2:10 (a river flows out of Eden to water the garden and divides into four rivers) and Revelation 20:7-8 (Satan released to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog). The line 'which are in the four corners of the earth' is set in larger type.

text.text: 10 Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it divided and became four rivers.

7 When the thousand years are completed, Satan will be released from his prison, 8 and will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together for the war; the number of them is like the sand of the seashore.

numbers.note: four rivers (Genesis 2:10) and four corners of the earth (Revelation 20:8)

uncertain: Reference header reads Revelation 20:8, but verse 7 is also quoted (shown with the red verse number 7).
